_comment: Contract ids per network. Written by scripts/deploy.mjs.

mainnet.note: Bound to Circle-issued USDC. Stellar's USDC carries 7 decimals, and the contract reads that from the asset at init rather than assuming.
mainnet.provenance: Deployed from this source before the adversarial test suite was added. The exported ABI is identical to what this tree builds — `pnpm run abi` checks it — but the executable hash differs: the deployment predates the toolchain pin in contracts/proved/rust-toolchain.toml and the build that produced it is not reproducible here. The hash this tree produces, a746a700…, is itself reproducible: two clean builds agree and it is stable across nightly 2026-05-20 through 2026-05-26. Redeploying would make the hashes identical and costs about 21 XLM.
